introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.paragraph1: sub.idler.me stores what the app needs to work and nothing else. This page says exactly what that is.
introduction.paragraph2: It is a small, one-person service. There is no company, no advertising, and no payment processing.

informationWeCollect.title: Information We Collect
informationWeCollect.description: What the database holds for your account:

items.account: Your email address, and the name or avatar your login provider returns.
items.subscription: The subscriptions you add: names, prices, currencies, billing dates, categories, and payment method labels.
items.expense: Which payments you marked as paid, and when.

items.providing: Show your subscriptions, reports, and payment history to you.
items.managing: Send the reminders you configured, to the channels you configured.
items.sending: Sign you in by email link.
items.improving: Nothing else. No profiling, no ad networks, no selling.

dataProtection.title: Data Protection
dataProtection.description: Data lives in a Postgres database on infrastructure the operator controls. It is not shared with third parties beyond the notification channels you enable yourself. There is no encryption-at-rest promise beyond the host's defaults.

analytics.title: Cookies and Analytics
analytics.description: No third-party analytics and no tracking scripts. The app stores your session cookie, your language choice, and your cookie preferences in your browser.

items.access: Export every record the app holds about you from the account page.
items.correct: Change your settings at any time.
items.delete: Ask for deletion of your account and its data.
items.optOut: Decline non-essential cookies in the cookie banner.

contactUs.description: If you have any questions about our Privacy Policy or how we handle your data, reach the operator on Matrix from the <link>contact page</link>.

updates.title: Updates to This Policy
updates.description: This page changes when the software or the deployment changes. The date at the top is the current version.

operator.title: Who Runs This
operator.description: sub.idler.me is operated by one person on self-hosted infrastructure as a community service, not a company. There is no payment processing and no advertising.
